learning_objectives.en: Order essay parts and proofread a sample answer.

passages.title: W-A
passages.text: Opinion essays should have a clear structure: introduction, main body and conclusion. Writers need to answer the question directly, organise their ideas logically and proofread carefully for grammar, spelling and punctuation.
